column1: # Normalized ligand SALCs in a Cartesian AO basis.
# Each data row gives one signed AO contribution to one SALC.
# salc_id syntax: irrep-energy_rank-partner_number (e.g. e1-A-1); A is lowest. Repeated ids are AO terms of the same SALC.
# ao_contribution syntax: signed amplitude*AO_label (not a population); signs encode phase/interference.
# AO labels are 2s, 2px, 2py, or 2pz. Normalize with the AO overlap matrix for nonorthogonal AOs.
# Coefficients are given to 15 significant digits; zero terms are omitted.
# Coordinates are in angstroms, and every ligand position scales linearly with d.
# d is the center-to-ligand distance in angstroms.
# Guessed energy rank: A = ligand s (-5.0), B = radial p sigma (-3.7),
# C = meridional p pi (-2.6), D = tangential p pi (-2.0), arbitrary units.
# Regular square antiprism with h/rho = 2^(-3/4), scaled so each ligand is d from center.
# Coordinate denominator is sqrt(4+sqrt(2)); site order follows the S8 orbit.
# The coordinates use d as their only variable geometric length.
